content: Hudai Buwa Maijixide
Ene Maijixideshi Salenni honshan wo, pse Zui Undu Hudai buwa wo. Iburaheimu honshanlai eghi injidene khareizhi irekude Maijixide hhei jienliezhi gouni kieliezho.
Iburaheimu eghinduzhi zhanjisan soyujilasene ushireini hhende ogizho. Maijixidei niereni tou 1 gie isishi gundan honshan wo, pse Salen honshan wo, jiushi pinnantu honshan wo.
Hhende ada, ana jiawu uwo. Hhei aminde qiorun, uzhu uwo. Hhe Hudai kewonyi xianli, chanqi buwa danlazho.
Ta nie sumula, ene kun matu fama wo! Famatu xienren Iburaheimu qianlazhi iresanne ushireini hhende ogiwo.
Liwini houdei dunda buwa danlachen kunla bexinlase ushirei ghura giezhi guijinde minlin ogizho. Ene bexinshi Iburaheimuse khizhesan hhelai gaijiuliuzhe buwala hhelase yen qingiezhi ghurazhoma,
Maijixideshi hhelare nie jiawu pusho, khareidene Iburaheimuse ushirei ghurazhi Hudai dainni jienliesan Iburaheimude onxian giezho.
Fugieni ganide onxian giese yama kieliekui uwo.
Ushirei ghurasan buwala fugunema, Maijixide jinwun jiere kieliesan mutun chanqi ulie fugune.
Ingiezhi kielieseye olune. Ushirei ghurasan Liwi goyane Iburaheimui tungo giezhi ushirei ogizho.
Ingiekushi MaijixideIburaheimui jienliekude Liwi xienrenne yasunde wo.
Isilie kunla Liwi paini buwai zhidui doura guijinni jienliewo. Ene zhiduni tungo giezhi hulunshise yale Hharuneni zhidui ese daghadene Maijixidei zhidui daghasan da nie buwai khizheghazho?
Buwani zhidui geise guijinniye ijinyo geine.
Ede kieliesan hheshi da nie painughun wo. Hhe paini kunla sidagha gieku teizi shida wilie giezhi nieda ese daozho.
Matanyi Ezhan Yuda paise khizhesanyi man mejiene. Ene paini kieliekude Musa buwai shiqinyi qiizhi ese daozho.
Maijixide mutun pse nie buwa khizhese ene shiqinla genjia qinchu oluwo.
Hhe buwa danlakushi Liwi paise khizhene giesan guijinghala pusho, ulie widaku aminni nenlighala wo.
Jinwun jiere hhende ganzhen beizhi kieliezho,
Niemande kieliese melieshidaku minlin zholien, yama zoin wise widaghawo.
Guijin yamai ese hulunshighawo. Pse niemande kieliese matande gou xiwon irezho. Ene xiwonyi tungo giezhi matan Hudai shigha shidane.
Pseshi Ersa buwa danlakude Huda fayen giezhi danlaghazho. Psedu buwalashi fayen giezhi danlaghasan pusho,
zinie Ersashi fayen giezhi danlaghasan wo. Huda hhende kieliezho,
Ersani fayen giezhi buwa danlaghase hheshi genjia gou yenjisanni baoran gholuwo.
Eqighandei buwa danlasan shuzi olon bikushi hhela man fugune. Ingiese izhigie buwa danla dazho.
Zinie Ersa chanqi wine. Ingiese hhei buwai wiliei chanqi ulie arunzhane.
Hhe chanqi amiturazhi hhelade oluzhi xiahua giezho. Ingiese jien hhei tungo giezhi Hudai melie iresanlai hhe jiuizhi uzhu kurugha shidane.
Intu zhiguitu, doghunnii wiku, zannannii wiku, zuirense ghugha keisan, asimanlase undudasan zui fugie buwa matande jian heshi wo.
Hhe psedu buwala mutun niudunie goyane zuide sidagha giedene khuinashi bexinlani zuide sidagha gieku biyo uwo. Hhe goyane 1 huide sidagha giedene enei man chenjighawo.
Guijinghala zui fugie buwa danlasanlade man zholienni winema, guijinni khuina Huda fayen giezhi chanqi hulunni gholusan Kewonne buwa danlaghawo.
